v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation
L7b quality fix - VAGUE_TASK cleared, input/output sections added

Initial release of minimalist-design-tool-free — a modern minimalist design system integration guide for personal frontend projects.

- Provides design tokens (colors, fonts, spacing, shadows) for consistent UI.
- Includes component specifications for buttons, cards, and input fields.
- Outlines responsive strategies and accessibility guidelines (WCAG 2.1 AA).
- Offers usage examples for Tailwind, CSS variables, and component structure.
- Suitable for individual developers and small teams adopting minimalist design.
